Some classic style infantry miniatures, hope you will have fun with them! They have the option to arms them to spear, sword or polearms too. The object contains chitubox files too, that I used to testprint them.

The files also include some very seperated files, these are designed to use them in Udo's Customizer software, this will allow you, to customize your miniatures inside the software, and you can print out the fully assambled miniatures! These files are not work with the software yet, but if you want to format they will work, check out this Cults3D project, where you can download the the files for the software: https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/medieval-infantry

Check out Udo's Patreon for more info how does that work: https://www.patreon.com/Udos3DWorld

If you like my work, and you would like to support me, and get all my previous designes, check out my Patreon, and consider to subscribe: https://www.patreon.com/ilhadiel

Feel free to check in my Discord: https://discord.gg/qa6afueK

A Gnome warrior miniature for tabletop games. Scaled for 28mm minis, so he is about 2.3 cm high. You can resize him if you want.
I made two versions of him, one with 2 axes, and one with an axe and a shield. There is no other differences of them, beside the weapons.

He is inspired by this art: https://www.artstation.com/artwork/enN2Z

Hope you will enjoy it.

If you like the models, please give this thing a Like.

If you printed out the models, please share a few pictures about them if you can.

If you enjoy the models, and the things that I make, please consider to tip me if you can, so I can continue to make more things.
